en: This is a vintage black and white postcard depicting a panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly landscape. The town has a prominent church with a tall steeple at its center, surrounded by houses, trees, and agricultural buildings. The foreground features farm buildings and what appears to be a riverbank or railway infrastructure. There is handwritten text at the top and bottom of the postcard. The name 'Unterdrauburg' is printed in the center bottom of the image.
